title: The x on Address 2 hides it and nothing is saved until Save
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with a value saved in Address 2.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's Edit Customer window.
  2. Hover over the x on Address 2.
  3. Click the x on Address 2.
  4. Click Cancel.
  5. Open customer A's Edit Customer window.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Address 2 shows its saved value, with an x button.

Step 2:

  • The tooltip reads "Remove Address 2".

Step 3:

  • Address 2 is cleared and hidden.
  • The + shows beside Address 1.

Step 4:

  • The window closes.

Step 5:

  • Address 2 shows its saved value again: nothing was saved.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12304 (Story 2, Bill Invoices To in New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S2-R7: “A shown Address 2 has an x button (tooltip "Remove Address 2") that clears and hides it; nothing is saved until Save.”
  • S2-R8: “A customer whose Address 2 holds a value opens with Address 2 showing, even when Address 1 is empty.”
